full_page.content:
c. 1949
The following is a faithful trnascription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Indiana
Blessed be God in all His designs!
God bless you M.K. Many thanks for your kind favor just noted - also for the several others unacknowledged.
This time I just thought "I'll write at once." Yes, thank God, my health has adjusted itself again so that hardly feel any effects of my dose of ptomane of two months ago .... Best regards to your Father, to Jack, and all our friends, and keep pleading for God's holy guidance.
Fr. Solanus, OFM Cap.
